applies_to.quote: To, All Authorised Dealers Madam/Sir, Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings

answer.action: Authorised Dealers must restrict INR NDDC offerings to non-residents to hedging purposes and maintain a Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve.
answer.action_quote: Authorised Dealers shall offer NDDCs involving INR to a non-resident user only for the purpose of hedging.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to foreign exchange derivative contracts undertaken after the issuance of these Directions.

answer.amends: Master Direction - Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings
